text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин beats out Мэдзиро Райан
and the
rest of the competition,
achieving her ultimate
goal in the spring
Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Filled with emotion, she announces her
victory
and expresses her gratitude to
everyone in her
family.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hearing her words, the crowd continues
to cheer
for her a while longer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
